schedule.heatmapHint: GitHub-style grid · click to set YO
schedule.markHint: Letters and color come from the profile. Here you set tables and hours.
schedule.settingsHint: How to read the grid: the past, tables, and the slot tooltip.
schedule.dimPastHint: Past slots go dark. Turn off to keep them as bright as the future.
schedule.hidePastDaysHint: Only today and the future stay on the month. Uncheck to bring the days back.
schedule.hidePastEmpty: Every day in this month has already passed. Uncheck “Hide past days” to see them again.
schedule.showTablesHint: Show the table count on each chip.
schedule.showTipHint: A card with the date, time, and who is in the slot. In Optimized grid it opens with the right click.
schedule.editModeHint: Marks can be placed or removed only while this is on — fewer accidental clicks.
schedule.slotLookHint: Tweak colors on the live grid. When you like it, copy the code and send it over.
schedule.playersHint: Hours = marks ÷ 2. Remaining counts only slots that have not passed in CET.
schedule.noShifts: No shifts of yours on this day
schedule.analyticsHint: Limit {{limit}} is open. Only this field is counted.

cabinet.title: Profile
cabinet.lead: Member card. Fields are still being agreed — this is a layout.

capacity.title: Capacity by CET hour
capacity.lead: Pick a limit and a matrix: month 31×24 or week 7×24. Click to set depth, then save.
capacity.matrixHint: One hour is 2 slots. The number on the right is the day total. Cell color is depth.
capacity.conflictHint: If both limits are on and they overlap, the stricter one wins: the lower capacity in each hour.
capacity.previewLook: How these days look on the schedule. Light cells are open, hatch is closed.
capacity.needSelect: Select days in the grid first.
capacity.resetLimitHint: Restores the shared rule: day 1, night 2. A day has 64 slots: 48 in the row plus 16 at night.
capacity.resetSelectedHint: Selected days go back to day 1 and night 2.
capacity.halfHint: One hour is 2 slots, one row is 48. Night at capacity 2 adds 16 more, 64 in the day.
capacity.specialDay: Day {{day}} has its own capacity rule.
capacity.equalize: Apply maximum capacity to every day
capacity.equalizeHint: If one date has capacity 3 and another has 1, the second day shows two fully locked levels. Day rows stay the same height.
capacity.daysHint: Unmarked dates use the All days rule. Click a date for its own rule. You can select several dates at once.
capacity.maxHint: This many rows will appear for the limit in one day
capacity.editHint: Click to raise capacity, right-click to lower it. Click and drag to select a range of hours.
capacity.previewHint: Light cells are open half-hour slots. Hatch means the level is closed. One row is 48 slots.

load.title: Hourly load
load.lead: A pastel rainbow washed over the grid: almost invisible on one hour, readable across the strip. Stored per limit as table hour_load.

people.title: Members
people.foldLead: Club list: nicks, limits, slot mark and VIP access. Only an admin edits the mark.
people.lead: Active members are the default view. Applications, pause, archive and bans stay in this list. VIP is a unique queue number: 1 is always first, 2 always second.
people.name: Name
people.empty: Nobody matches — clear the filter or change status.
people.vipHint: Empty means no priority. The number is unique: 1 is always first in queue.
people.markHint: Pick the chip color and the letter color from the palette or paste a #hex, then type the letters. Below is how the mark looks in a slot.
people.profileSoon: Wallets, Telegram and admin notes will land here later. For now: Discord ID, email, limits and VIP access.

marks.title: Marks
marks.lead: 200 colors in hue families, without washed-out yellows and oranges. Each swatch only offers high-contrast inks. Letters, Discord nick, and the pair “color family + ink” stay unique. PL is reserved for the club head.
marks.reserved: Until letters are set, the sample shows PL. Tables on the preview are always 12. Search: Discord nick, room nick in parentheses.
marks.dupNick: This Discord nick is already on another color
marks.dupCombo: A similar color already uses this type color

skin.label: Grid
skin.optHint: With edit mode on: click to set, double-click to clear. Right-click for details.

tip.lockedHint: This hour has capacity {{cap}}. Marks are allowed when capacity is at least {{need}}.
tip.markTables: Left click adds tables, right click removes them. The current number is saved on the slot and does not change later.

foot.title: Fill by CET
foot.lead: Each bar is the same half-hour as the grid, across every day and level on screen. 100% means no empty slots, 0% means all free.
foot.more: Space below is reserved for later month slices: player hours, VIP, limits. For now it just marks the end of the field.

help.title: How the schedule works
help.lead: The everyday bits, parked at the bottom so they stay out of the grid.

edit.p: Turn on the checkbox at the top right. Without it, marks are not placed or removed — fewer accidental clicks.

place.p: Single-click a free slot. It stores your mark and the current table count.

remove.p: Double-click your own mark. Other people’s marks stay put.

tables.p: Click the mark sample next to the checkbox. Plus, minus, or type a number, then OK.

tip.p: Right-click a slot for who is there, CET, and local time. Settings can turn this off.

search.p: Type two letters in the Aa field. Other marks fade; the hit pulses.

settings.p: The gear: dim the past, hide past days, tables on marks, and the slot tooltip.

cursor.p: Date and limit light up on the left, hour and half-hour on top. In edit mode a frame wraps the whole hour of that day.
